## NEW ENTRY DETAIL — AWS Agent Registry cross-account sharing with AWS RAM
Doc: .../devguide/registry-cross-account-sharing.html
Shareable RAM resource type: `agent-registry:Registry`. Owner selects ONE managed permission:
- AWSRAMDefaultPermissionAgentRegistryReadOnly  (default if none specified)
    GetRegistry, GetRegistryRecord, ListRegistryRecords,
    SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords, GetDiscoverableRegistryRecord, ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords
    => NO MCP invoke.
- AWSRAMPermissionAgentRegistryForConsumer   *** AWS RECOMMENDS THIS AS THE DEFAULT CHOICE ***
    the three Discoverable ops + **agent-registry:InvokeRegistryMcp**
    => the share is a LIVE TOOL-INVOCATION GRANT, not a read grant.
- AWSRAMPermissionAgentRegistryForPublisher
    Consumer + GetRegistry, CreateRegistryRecord, UpdateRegistryRecord, DeleteRegistryRecord,
    GetRegistryRecord, ListRegistryRecords, SubmitRegistryRecordForApproval
- AWSRAMPermissionAgentRegistryForAdmin
    Publisher + **UpdateRegistryRecordStatus** (approve / reject / deprecate)
    => curation authority delegated to a FOREIGN ACCOUNT.
UpdateRegistry / DeleteRegistry NEVER delegable — always the owner's.

## KEY RULES — NEW THIS SCAN
- ORG-INTERNAL SHARES AUTO-ACCEPT. With RAM sharing-with-Organizations enabled, "acceptance is
  automatic — no invitation is required." Only EXTERNAL (cross-org) shares send an invitation.
  => in the common enterprise case there is NO consumer-side consent event to observe.
- REVOCATION IS EVENTUALLY CONSISTENT: ~30 s of continued access after disassociate-resource-share.
- CONDITION KEYS HAVE AN ENUMERATION HOLE. Two keys, resolved at authz time from the stored record,
  cannot be spoofed from request input:
      agent-registry:RecordCreatorAccount
      agent-registry:RecordSourceAccount
  They are NOT evaluated on CreateRegistryRecord, and NOT on
      SearchDiscoverableRegistryRecords / ListRegistryRecords / ListDiscoverableRegistryRecords
  which "return summaries for all matching records regardless of condition-key restrictions."
  AWS's own remedy is to withhold search+list from the share — which defeats the purpose.
  => a consumer scoped to its own records can still enumerate the WHOLE catalogue.
- Owner needs ram:CreateResourceShare + agent-registry:PutResourcePolicy. Registry must be READY.

## KEY RULES CARRIED FORWARD (unchanged)
- Memory extraction asymmetry IS the detection rule (/short-term-create-event.html):
  "Conversational and JSON payloads are extracted into long-term memory. Blob payloads are stored
   in short-term memory only and are not extracted."
  => the memory WRITE PATH NO LONGER REQUIRES A CONVERSATION. Payload TYPE, not size or source,
     decides whether stored data can influence future sessions.
- x402 `upto` pays a METERED AMOUNT UP TO A CEILING via the Permit2 contract; MPP forwards a
  `WWW-Authenticate: Payment` challenge VERBATIM to ProcessPayment, which checks the SESSION BUDGET
  and SIGNS WITH THE WALLET. Methods: evm, tempo, solana.
- Third-party evaluators are discoverable via `ListEvaluators` ALONGSIDE built-in and custom —
  provenance is NOT distinguished on the inventory surface.

## July 2026 and earlier — unchanged
Web Search connector v1.2.0; Identity Private Key JWT client auth; Harness InvokeHarness streams MCP
tool result metadata; Runtime unified span destination; Evaluations/Optimizations PrivateLink;
Evaluations framework support; ActiveSessionCount metric. Earlier: Web Search GA, Policy + Bedrock
Guardrails, Harness GA, Recommendations GA, Batch Evaluations GA, A/B Testing GA, Managed Knowledge
Base GA, Failure Insights preview, Gateway Runtime/HTTP-passthrough/inference targets, Runtime
Interactive Shells, Step Functions, CLI/CDK payments support.

**Operation-for-operation identical to the 2026-08-07 capture. THIRD consecutive verification with
no net-new operations.** `SearchRegistryRecords` remains the only registry op on that page; the
RAM-shared discovery ops and `InvokeRegistryMcp` live on the separate `agent-registry` API surface.
See amazon-bedrock-agentcore_api.txt.
